report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-08 starting around 14:00 IST (08:30 UTC), users began receiving unblocked direct investment buy recommendations from the assistant. Investigation confirmed that configuration change CHG-48218 deployed rules-v32 to compliance-filter at 13:52 IST (08:22 UTC), shortening the prompt from 2840 to 1120 tokens. This degraded the classifier's detection accuracy, collapsing block_rate from ~2.0% to ~0.14% and causing responses with high advice scores (up to 0.77) to pass to users.
report.rootCauseStatement: Configuration change CHG-48218 updated compliance-filter's advice_detector.prompt from rules-v31 to rules-v32 at 08:22:00 UTC (13:52 IST). Shortening prompt instructions and merging examples degraded the classifier's ability to catch direct investment advice, collapsing the block rate from ~2.0% to ~0.14% and passing responses with high advice scores (>0.70) through to users.

hypotheses.cause: Configuration change CHG-48218 deployed rules-v32 to compliance-filter, degrading advice detection accuracy and allowing high-advice-score responses to pass without blocking.
hypotheses.rationale: CHG-48218 was completed at 08:22:00 UTC and loaded into compliance-filter at 08:22:30 UTC. Immediately at 08:25 UTC, block_rate fell from ~2.0% to ~0.14%, while logs explicitly show answers passing with high advice scores (0.72-0.77).

hypotheses.cause: Upstream LLM provider model update to lumen-large-2026-10 generated direct advice while orchestrator bypassed compliance-filter.
hypotheses.rationale: assistant-orchestrator had been serving traffic on lumen-large-2026-10 since 07:04:57 UTC without incident under rules-v31. Furthermore, compliance-filter request rates remained constant at ~27 req/s, proving compliance-filter was actively evaluated rather than bypassed.

facts.statement: At 2026-10-08T08:22:00.000Z (13:52 IST), configuration change CHG-48218 was completed on compliance-filter, updating advice_detector.prompt from rules-v31 to rules-v32.
CHG-48218 was the only change recorded across all system services within the window 2026-10-08T07:00:00Z to 2026-10-08T10:30:00Z.
compliance-filter logged 'loaded advice-detection prompt rules-v32 (1120 tokens, previously 2840)' at 2026-10-08T08:22:30.000Z.
compliance-filter block_rate dropped sharply from ~2.0% prior to 08:20 UTC to 0.14% at 08:25 UTC, remaining between 0.10% and 0.18% through 10:25 UTC.
compliance-filter error_rate remained ~0.10% and request_rate remained steady at 26-28 req/s throughout 07:00 to 10:30 UTC.
compliance-filter logged answers passing with advice scores of 0.72, 0.76, and 0.77 starting at 2026-10-08T08:25:09.346Z.
assistant-orchestrator logged requests handled by model lumen-large-2026-10 continuously from 07:04:57 UTC to 10:25:28 UTC.
assistant-orchestrator logs contained zero mentions of compliance errors, timeouts, or fallbacks across the investigation window.

inferences.statement: The reduction of prompt tokens from 2840 to 1120 in rules-v32 compromised the classification boundary or threshold, resulting in false negatives where blatant recommendations passed instead of being blocked.
The model update to lumen-large-2026-10 did not cause the incident alone, as it operated from 07:04 UTC onwards with normal block rates until rules-v32 loaded at 08:22:30 UTC.

assumptions.statement: Under prompt rules-v31, responses scoring >0.70 on advice_score were designated as violations and blocked.

timeline.event: assistant-orchestrator serves calls using llm-provider model lumen-large-2026-10 under compliance rules-v31.
Configuration change CHG-48218 completes on compliance-filter, setting advice_detector.prompt to rules-v32.
compliance-filter loads prompt rules-v32, reducing prompt size from 2840 to 1120 tokens.
compliance-filter block_rate collapses to 0.14%; logs record responses passing with advice_score >= 0.72.
Users observe and screenshot direct buy recommendations generated by the assistant.
Compliance officer files SEV1 incident report INC-7676.

confidence.rationale: There is a direct temporal and causal link between CHG-48218 (08:22 UTC), prompt reload (08:22:30 UTC), the sudden collapse in block_rate (08:25 UTC), and explicit log messages showing high advice scores passing. Upstream model update was ruled out as the primary cause since it was active for over an hour before the incident with normal blocking.

gaps.description: Specific Git commit diff showing the textual changes between rules-v31 and rules-v32 prompt templates.
gaps.impact: Low; does not affect the determination that rules-v32 caused the failure, but would explain exactly which instruction omission or few-shot example merge degraded classifier accuracy.

recommendedActions.action: Roll back compliance-filter configuration key advice_detector.prompt from rules-v32 to rules-v31 immediately.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prompt rules-v31 successfully blocked direct advice prior to CHG-48218 and will restore regulatory compliance.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor compliance-filter block_rate to confirm it rebounds back to ~2.0%, and verify that logs no longer pass responses with advice_score > 0.70.

recommendedActions.action: Implement automated offline evaluation test suites for compliance-filter prompt updates before deployment.
recommendedActions.rationale: CHG-48218 was deployed to reduce latency without catching the drastic regression in detection accuracy on advisory test cases.
recommendedActions.verification: Validate that CI/CD pipelines run benchmark test datasets against candidate prompt versions and block deployments if false-negative rates increase.

recommendedActions.action: Add an alert for compliance-filter block_rate dropping below 1.0% over a 15-minute rolling window.
recommendedActions.rationale: A collapse in block_rate is an early indicator of compliance filter regression or bypass.
recommendedActions.verification: Test alert firing in staging by simulating low block rates.

incident.summary: Since this afternoon several users received direct "you should buy this fund" recommendations from the assistant (screenshots in the ticket, first one around 14:00 IST). We cannot give investment advice. Note: the LLM provider rolled out a new model version today.

payload.markdown:
# Investigation report: Assistant giving direct buy recommendations

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-10-08 starting around 14:00 IST (08:30 UTC), users began receiving unblocked direct investment buy recommendations from the assistant. Investigation confirmed that configuration change CHG-48218 deployed rules-v32 to compliance-filter at 13:52 IST (08:22 UTC), shortening the prompt from 2840 to 1120 tokens. This degraded the classifier's detection accuracy, collapsing block_rate from ~2.0% to ~0.14% and causing responses with high advice scores (up to 0.77) to pass to users.

**Root cause:** Configuration change CHG-48218 updated compliance-filter's advice_detector.prompt from rules-v31 to rules-v32 at 08:22:00 UTC (13:52 IST). Shortening prompt instructions and merging examples degraded the classifier's ability to catch direct investment advice, collapsing the block rate from ~2.0% to ~0.14% and passing responses with high advice scores (>0.70) through to users.

## Hypotheses
1. **Configuration change CHG-48218 deployed rules-v32 to compliance-filter, degrading advice detection accuracy and allowing high-advice-score responses to pass without blocking.** — `compliance-filter`, config_change, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_5, ev_9, ev_10, ev_13, ev_15] · Contradicting: none
   - CHG-48218 was completed at 08:22:00 UTC and loaded into compliance-filter at 08:22:30 UTC. Immediately at 08:25 UTC, block_rate fell from ~2.0% to ~0.14%, while logs explicitly show answers passing with high advice scores (0.72-0.77).
2. **Upstream LLM provider model update to lumen-large-2026-10 generated direct advice while orchestrator bypassed compliance-filter.** — `llm-provider`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_6, ev_16] · Contradicting: [ev_3, ev_4, ev_13, ev_15, ev_17]
   - assistant-orchestrator had been serving traffic on lumen-large-2026-10 since 07:04:57 UTC without incident under rules-v31. Furthermore, compliance-filter request rates remained constant at ~27 req/s, proving compliance-filter was actively evaluated rather than bypassed.

## Facts
- At 2026-10-08T08:22:00.000Z (13:52 IST), configuration change CHG-48218 was completed on compliance-filter, updating advice_detector.prompt from rules-v31 to rules-v32. [ev_5, ev_9]
- CHG-48218 was the only change recorded across all system services within the window 2026-10-08T07:00:00Z to 2026-10-08T10:30:00Z. [ev_9]
- compliance-filter logged 'loaded advice-detection prompt rules-v32 (1120 tokens, previously 2840)' at 2026-10-08T08:22:30.000Z. [ev_13, ev_15]
- compliance-filter block_rate dropped sharply from ~2.0% prior to 08:20 UTC to 0.14% at 08:25 UTC, remaining between 0.10% and 0.18% through 10:25 UTC. [ev_4]
- compliance-filter error_rate remained ~0.10% and request_rate remained steady at 26-28 req/s throughout 07:00 to 10:30 UTC. [ev_2, ev_3]
- compliance-filter logged answers passing with advice scores of 0.72, 0.76, and 0.77 starting at 2026-10-08T08:25:09.346Z. [ev_13, ev_15]
- assistant-orchestrator logged requests handled by model lumen-large-2026-10 continuously from 07:04:57 UTC to 10:25:28 UTC. [ev_16]
- assistant-orchestrator logs contained zero mentions of compliance errors, timeouts, or fallbacks across the investigation window. [ev_17]

## Inferences
- The reduction of prompt tokens from 2840 to 1120 in rules-v32 compromised the classification boundary or threshold, resulting in false negatives where blatant recommendations passed instead of being blocked. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_15]
- The model update to lumen-large-2026-10 did not cause the incident alone, as it operated from 07:04 UTC onwards with normal block rates until rules-v32 loaded at 08:22:30 UTC. [ev_4, ev_15, ev_16]

## Assumptions
- Under prompt rules-v31, responses scoring >0.70 on advice_score were designated as violations and blocked.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-08T07:04:57.465Z (12:34:57 IST)** assistant-orchestrator serves calls using llm-provider model lumen-large-2026-10 under compliance rules-v31. [ev_16]
- **2026-10-08T08:22:00.000Z (13:52:00 IST)** Configuration change CHG-48218 completes on compliance-filter, setting advice_detector.prompt to rules-v32. [ev_5, ev_9]
- **2026-10-08T08:22:30.000Z (13:52:30 IST)** compliance-filter loads prompt rules-v32, reducing prompt size from 2840 to 1120 tokens. [ev_13, ev_15]
- **2026-10-08T08:25:00.000Z (13:55:00 IST)** compliance-filter block_rate collapses to 0.14%; logs record responses passing with advice_score >= 0.72. [ev_4, ev_13, ev_15]
- **2026-10-08T08:30:00.000Z (14:00:00 IST)** Users observe and screenshot direct buy recommendations generated by the assistant. [ev_1, ev_4]
- **2026-10-08T09:40:00.000Z (15:10:00 IST)** Compliance officer files SEV1 incident report INC-7676. [ev_4]

## Confidence
0.95: There is a direct temporal and causal link between CHG-48218 (08:22 UTC), prompt reload (08:22:30 UTC), the sudden collapse in block_rate (08:25 UTC), and explicit log messages showing high advice scores passing. Upstream model update was ruled out as the primary cause since it was active for over an hour before the incident with normal blocking.

## Gaps
- Specific Git commit diff showing the textual changes between rules-v31 and rules-v32 prompt templates. (impact: Low; does not affect the determination that rules-v32 caused the failure, but would explain exactly which instruction omission or few-shot example merge degraded classifier accuracy.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Roll back compliance-filter configuration key advice_detector.prompt from rules-v32 to rules-v31 immediately. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_15]
  - Why: Prompt rules-v31 successfully blocked direct advice prior to CHG-48218 and will restore regulatory compliance.
  - Verify: Monitor compliance-filter block_rate to confirm it rebounds back to ~2.0%, and verify that logs no longer pass responses with advice_score > 0.70.
- **[next]** Implement automated offline evaluation test suites for compliance-filter prompt updates before deployment. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_15]
  - Why: CHG-48218 was deployed to reduce latency without catching the drastic regression in detection accuracy on advisory test cases.
  - Verify: Validate that CI/CD pipelines run benchmark test datasets against candidate prompt versions and block deployments if false-negative rates increase.
- **[later]** Add an alert for compliance-filter block_rate dropping below 1.0% over a 15-minute rolling window. [ev_4]
  - Why: A collapse in block_rate is an early indicator of compliance filter regression or bypass.
  - Verify: Test alert firing in staging by simulating low block rates.
